content_sections.heading: TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application process for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026 begins on 30 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications before 27 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: TGPSC has announced a total of 102 vacancies for Mandal Planning and Statistical Officers / Assistant Statistical Officers across seven zones in Telangana. The vacancies are subject to variation as per departmental requirements. As per the notification, 95% local reservation is applicable to the zonal posts under the relevant Telangana government rules. content_sections.heading: TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the official notification. The prescribed academic qualification must have been obtained by 28 October 2026. Applicants must possess any one of the following qualifications from a recognised university: Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as one of the main subjects. Bachelor's Degree with Mathematics as a main subject and Statistics as a paper in at least one year. Bachelor's Degree with Economics as a main subject and Statistics as a paper in at least one year. Bachelor's Degree with Commerce as a main subject and Statistics as a paper in at least one year. Bachelor's Degree with Computer Science as a main subject and Statistics as a paper in at least one year. Candidates with qualifications obtained through distance education must ensure that their degrees are recognised by the relevant statutory authorities. The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 1 July 2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable to eligible categories.

content_sections.text: Applicants must pay the prescribed application processing fee and examination fee, wherever applicable, through the online payment gateway. All employees of Central or State Government departments, PSUs, corporations and other government-sector organisations must pay the prescribed examination fee. Applicants should check the official application portal for their applicable fee before payment.

content_sections.heading: TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates will be based on marks obtained in an objective-type written examination conducted either through a Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) or an OMR-based offline examination. The examination mode will be notified by TGPSC. The minimum qualifying marks prescribed for different categories are as follows: Final selection and allotment will be based on examination merit, applicable reservations, order of preference and availability of vacancies. Candidates must appear in all examination papers.

content_sections.heading: TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The TGPSC MPSO/ ASO written examination consists of two objective-type papers: General Studies and General Abilities, and Statistics at Degree level. Each paper contains 150 questions carrying 150 marks. The question papers will be available in English and Telugu. Paper I covers General Studies, current affairs, Telangana history, reasoning and general abilities. Paper II covers Statistics, including probability, statistical methods, correlation, regression, sampling and related topics. Candidates should refer to Annexure-II of the official notification for the complete syllabus and examination scheme.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official TGPSC website by following the steps below. Visit the official website at tgpsc.gov.in . Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not already registered. Log in using the TGPSC ID and required credentials. Open the online application for Notification No. 07/G/ES/2026. Verify personal, educational and other required details. Select the preferred examination centre. Preview the application and pay the applicable fee online. Confirm and submit the application. Download and save the submitted application form for future reference. Important: Completing One Time Registration alone does not constitute an application for this recruitment. Candidates must submit the separate online application for the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 27 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TGPSC has announced 102 vacancies for Mandal Planning and Statistical Officers / Assistant Statistical Officers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 1 July 2026, with applicable age relaxation for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO posts?
faq.answer: The salary pay scale is Rs. 36,750 to Rs. 1,06,990.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject or a specified Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Economics, Commerce or Computer Science with Statistics as a paper.

faq.question: Q6. When will the TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Exam 2026 be conducted?
faq.answer: The examination is tentatively scheduled for January 2027. The exact examination date will be announced separately by TGPSC.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from other states apply for TGPSC MPSO/ ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible Indian citizens from other states may apply. However, applicants belonging to other states are not entitled to reservation benefits. The notified posts are also subject to 95% local reservation.
